description: This file defines the ForNode class in the Twig templating engine, representing a 'for' loop node within the abstract syntax tree. It includes methods for constructing the node and compiling it into executable PHP code.

classes.name: ForNode
classes.description: Represents a 'for' loop node in the Twig template AST, responsible for executing loop logic and code compilation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ForNode with key/value targets, sequence expression, optional conditions, body, else node, and line number.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the ForNode into PHP code that performs the loop when the template is rendered.
